name: God's Own Junkyard
description: A dazzling warehouse full of neon signs, vintage film props and salvaged art. Free entry, with a bar and kitchen next door at the Rolling Scones cafe. One of the most photographed spots in E17.
address: Unit 12, Ravenswood Industrial Estate, Shernhall St, E17 9HQ
tip: Go on a Saturday or Sunday when it's open to the public. The cafe does a solid brunch and you can sit among the neon while you eat.
